hook.from: Geography > Location, Terrain, Natural resources; Economy > Exports
hook.excerpt: Caribbean, island in the North Atlantic Ocean, northeast of Venezuela || relatively flat; rises gently to central highland region || easternmost Caribbean island || Resources: petroleum, fish, natural gas || Exports: liquor, refined petroleum, packaged medicine, margarine, baked goods (2023)

physicalGeography.excerpt: relatively flat; rises gently to central highland region || Caribbean, island in the North Atlantic Ocean, northeast of Venezuela

climate.excerpt: tropical; rainy season (June to October) || infrequent hurricanes; periodic landslides

economy.excerpt: high-income Eastern Caribbean economy; high standard of living among regional peers; key tourism, construction, and financial sectors driving recent GDP growth; declining but still very high public debt leading to IMF support programs; susceptible to natural disasters and reliance on import partners || Exports: liquor, refined petroleum, packaged medicine, margarine, baked goods (2023) || Industries: tourism, sugar, light manufacturing, component assembly for export
